profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at EF, Web Accessibility Specialist (WAS)

positions.title: Rapid Application Developer
positions.description: Quickly turn designs and concepts into web and iOS mobile apps to better the customer experience in stores.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on front-end development and content management for various projects, utilizing knowledge of HTML/CSS, jQuery, and Bootstrap, as well as learning basic knowledge of how to integrate front-end with Sitecore by familiarizing self with C#.

positions.title: Creative Engineer
positions.description: Carried out front-end web development work on various projects, further developing knowledge of HTML/CSS and jQuery, as well as learn new frameworks on the job such as Handlebars and Sass.

positions.title: Women's Shoes Sales Associate
positions.description: Assist customers in finding, fitting, and purchasing shoes.

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description: This was a summer internship at the San Mateo County Parks Department.  During my time there, I designed, printed, laminated, and mounted signs on sheets of metal.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Assisted customers, worked registers and customer service desk.
